eval_cases.description: UC-1.1: Frontline Lead Cashier resolving ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze on Toshiba TCx 810 with double charge avoidance and GCS manual citation.

parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

When a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 (EMV PIN Pad Tokenization Timeout) freeze on the Toshiba TCx 810 terminal, follow this protocol:
1. Prevent Double-Charging: Do NOT re-swipe, tap, or charge the customer's card again immediately.
2. Reboot Payment Module: Hold Yellow + # on the payment PIN pad for 3 seconds to reboot the module.
3. Inspect Connection: Check the 12V PoweredUSB cable connection in the rear I/O channel.
4. Audit Transaction Status: Navigate to Manager Menu -> Journal Audit Slip on the Toshiba TCx 810 terminal.
5. Status Resolution: If status displays AUTHORIZED_UNSETTLED, print receipt slip. If VOIDED_ERROR, re-scan and request card presentation.
Reference: Toshiba TCx 810 Guide (https://storage.cloud.google.com/da-advanced-new-module1-bucket/store_pos_manual_generic/Toshiba_TCx_810_Guide.pdf)

eval_cases.description: UC-1.1: Store clerk resolving terminal thermal printer cutter lock error code ERR-DN-PRNT-24V on Diebold Nixdorf Beetle A1150.

parts.text: How do store clerks resolve a terminal thermal printer cutter lock error code ERR-DN-PRNT-24V on a Diebold Nixdorf Beetle terminal?

To resolve ERR-DN-PRNT-24V (Thermal Printer Cutter Jam / Head Lock) on the Diebold Nixdorf Beetle terminal:
1. Power Off: Switch off printer power and disconnect the 24V PoweredUSB cable.
2. Manual Release: Open the front cutter access cover and rotate the manual thumb-wheel clockwise until the cutter blade fully retracts.
3. Paper Path Clear: Clear any crumpled receipt paper fragments from the paper feed roller.
4. Reconnect & Test: Reconnect the 24V cable, power on, and feed 3 test lines via the paper feed button.
Reference: Diebold Nixdorf Beetle Guide (https://storage.cloud.google.com/da-advanced-new-module1-bucket/store_pos_manual_generic/Diebold_Nixdorf_Beetle_Guide.pdf)
